$comment: Accepted npm audit advisories. Every entry is a dated, reasoned decision;
scripts/audit-check.py fails on any high/critical advisory that is not
listed here, and also fails when a listed advisory no longer appears -- a
dead exception is removed, not left to rot.
Adding an entry is a security decision: record why the risk is acceptable,
not merely that a fix is unavailable.

accepted.reason: Stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs. Reached only through @prisma/client -> prisma -> @prisma/config, whose sole merge input is our own committed Prisma configuration; no attacker-controlled path exists. No fixed release on Prisma 7.10 -- npm's suggested fix is a downgrade to Prisma 6, a breaking stack change. See docs/knowledge/project-state.md.
accepted.recheck: When Prisma publishes a release that bumps deepmerge-ts to >=8.
